link.title: Chrome's Built-in AI — from 0 to superhero
link.description: An on-device AI course for the web: the Prompt API, Summarizer, Translator + Language Detector, Writer/Rewriter, Proofreader, Embeddings, Multimodal, WebMCP, Generative UI, and an in-browser MCP client — plus observability, tracing, and evaluation. Everything runs on-device via Chrome's built-in Gemini Nano: no backend, no API keys, no data leaving the machine.
